owner_and_capability: Ninth slice of #4076, People Directory and the retained users repositories read the student directory and guardian-link projections through ports they declare (ADR 0058): People Directory's student reads move into its own postgres adapter over a StudentDirectory row-source port, guardian links come through a GuardianLinks port, and the users repositories take StudentDirectoryRows and GuardianLinkRows; the root binds the projection readers.
affected_tables: None: no DDL or table ownership change.
atomic_cutover: Code cutover without a new rule or policy epoch. The student list, directory, record, lock (FOR UPDATE / UPDATE NOWAIT), roster, enrollment, departure-mode and care-end reads move from modules/studentdirectoryview into modules/peopledirectory/internal/adapters/postgres/directory_*.go with unchanged SQL and run over StudentRows/StudentModelRows of the bound reader in the caller's transaction. modules/guardianlinkview/compose builds the guardian reader; peopleCompose.Dependencies.StudentDirectory is required and GuardianLinkRows is set by every root that serves guardian reads. Staff offboarding receives People Directory from the root (MustNewReads, the same unobserved setup); the staff-notice name adapter moves to api/staff_notice_names.go. Test support uses testpkg.StudentDirectory and testpkg.GuardianLinks. Stale rules student-directory-view.postgres.departure-contract and student-directory-view.postgres.people-public are deleted.
tests: People Directory, users repository, Care Plan, staff offboarding and root suites through test-changed.
scripts/run-go-toolchain.sh scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast; scripts/backend-architecture.sh check; validate-ticket --all.
